Model specifications

Source: R/model-spec.R
new_mt_spec.Rd

Every model is created by a constructor (rwd(), lee_carter(), tucker3(), arima_series(), ets_series(), apc_bayes(), ensemble()) that returns an mt_spec object. Specifications are fitted with mt_fit() and forecast with mt_forecast().

Usage

new_mt_spec(
  model,
  params = list(),
  joint = FALSE,
  min_periods = 5,
  label = model,
  smooth = TRUE
)

Arguments

model

Model name (used in the class).

params

List of parameters.

joint

Whether the model is fitted jointly across strata.

min_periods

Minimum number of periods in the training data.

label

Display name.

smooth

Whether the draws describe expected (underlying) rates (TRUE, for example Lee-Carter: predictive draws add Poisson variation of the deaths given these rates and the exposures) or observed rates (FALSE, for example a random walk on observed log rates: predictive draws add nothing).

Value

An object of class c("mt_spec_<model>", "mt_spec").

Details

new_mt_spec() is the constructor for developers who add models: a model class mt_spec_<name> needs methods for the internal generics fit_model() and simulate_model(). Per-stratum models receive matrices [age, period] of deaths and exposures; joint models (joint = TRUE) receive arrays [age, period, stratum]. simulate_model() returns rates [age, horizon, draw] (per stratum) or [age, horizon, stratum, draw] (joint).
